title: Access to Basic Amenities by State & District
description: Proportion of households with access to basic amenities such as electricity, piped water, and sanitary latrines by state and district.

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 16 states, including the 3 Federal Territories

fields.name: district
fields.title: District
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 160 administrative districts, including the 4 states (Perlis and the 3 Federal Territories) which do not have subdivisions, or 'All Districts' for the state totals

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: piped_water
fields.title: Piped Water
fields.description: [Float] Percentage of households with access to piped water at home

fields.name: sanitation
fields.title: Sanitation
fields.description: [Float] Percentage of households covered by sanitary latrines

fields.name: electricity
fields.title: Electricity
fields.description: [Float] Percentage of households with access to electricity at home

methodology: This data represents estimates of households' access to various basic amenities, and is tabulated from household-level survey data collected via the Household Income and Expenditure Survey (HIES), which is conducted at least twice within any 5-year period. For full details on the methodology, especially on the nuances involved in sampling, please refer to the [technical notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/hies-technotes).
publication: The [Household Income Survey Report, 2024](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/household_income_2024), the latest edition of the household income statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on household income](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/household-income-expenditure) which enables you to explore Malaysia's household income data interactively.
